Subject: Request: split implementation + schedule change (amendment)

Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo today. Our execs want to proceed, but they asked for two changes before legal will sign: a phased rollout (Phase 1: ingestion & sandbox, Phase 2: live inference) and a one-month delay to our original go-live so operations can complete integration testing. Key asks below: 

- Split SOW into Phase 1 and Phase 2 with explicit deliverables per phase.
- Add capacity for Phase 2: +50% concurrent throughput for 6 months after go-live.
- Update payment schedule: prorated invoice for the delayed month, and an optional accelerated payment discount.
- Clarify SLA during Phase 1 (sandbox vs production) and rollback / termination rights if latency targets unmet.

Can you send an amendment or redlined SOW that covers these items? Legal wants a short review window — they would like the amendment in hand by EOD 20 May so their counsel can review before our board meeting.

Thanks,
Tom

Team —

Looping you in to get redlines back quickly. Client asked for: phased SOW (Phase 1 sandbox, Phase 2 production), a one-month go-live delay (proposed new target 2027-07-01), +50% capacity in Phase 2 for 6 months, and a payment/proration change. Subject: Re: Internal: Feedlot Health amendment - urgent legal & finance review

Stephanie / team,

Thanks for the summary. I looked through draft_amendment_v0.1 and cost_impact_table. High-level legal guidance below — Ill attach inline redlines (amendment_redlines_rishi.docx) with proposed language.

- SOW split is fine as an "Amendment No. 2" to the Order Form. Keep the MSA intact.
- Reserved capacity vs autoscaling: recommend we offer both options in the amendment (committed reserved capacity pricing and an autoscale surcharge). Provide an explicit conversion clause if they want to convert autoscale usage into a reserved commitment during the 6-month window.
- SLA/rollback: for Phase 1 label as "pre-production" with target-based milestones (integration complete, baseline latency) and no service credits; Phase 2 should map to standard SLA with a 30-day remediation window, then termination rights. Avoid open-ended termination windows.
- Pricing/proration: suggest prorating by day for the delayed month and offer a 2% accelerated-payment discount (not to exceed a capped amount). Finance sign-off needed.
- Data/KMS: surface the KMS/HSM requirement only if they request customer-managed keys; otherwise keep existing MSA data controls in place.

Ill upload amendment_redlines_rishi.docx with tracked changes. Please review the redlines and let me know if product or ops need different milestone definitions.

Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra

- Defines Phase 1 as pre-production (limited SLA) and Phase 2 as subject to standard SLA with a 30-day remediation/termination path.
- Includes a 2% accelerated-payment discount option (finance to confirm).
